name: Isle of Wight County, VA
findings: Isle of Wight County has 117 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Isle of Wight County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Isle of Wight County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
